title: Book Three · Chapter 37: The Hard Last Turn
story:
On Tuesday, Anna tries four laps at lunch.

Ronan runs his own two first. Then he walks to the bench. Her friend is there with three bottles beside her feet.

“How many?” he asks.

“Third. She started after you.”

Anna comes round the near turn. Her steps look steady. She passes the bench and lifts one hand.

Her friend holds up three fingers.

Ronan sits down. Across the grass, Kai and two boys are kicking a ball. A teacher walks along the far edge of the field.

The fourth lap takes longer. At the far turn, Anna slows. She keeps running for a few steps, then stops.

Ronan begins to stand.

Her friend looks at him. “Wait.”

Anna walks with her hands at her sides. Then she bends for a moment and rests her hands on her knees.

The teacher comes nearer. Anna speaks to him and shakes her head once. After a little while, she walks toward the bench.

Ronan takes her bottle from the ground.

“Here.”

She drinks, then sits down. Her face is hot and cross.

“Too fast?” he asks.

“Maybe. The last bit felt awful.”

Her friend sits beside her.

“The second lap was quick. I saw you pass the boy in blue.”

Anna looks back at the track.

“I wanted to catch him.”

Ronan remembers the first day. He ran after her feet until he had to slow down.

“He isn't in your run on Saturday,” he says.

“I know.”

She says it sharply. Ronan closes his mouth.

For a moment, he watches Kai's ball instead. Anna drinks again. Her friend puts the bottle top near her hand.

“Sorry,” Anna says after a while. “I am cross with my legs.”

“I don't want to stop on Saturday,” she adds.

Her friend shakes her head. “You can stop if you need to.”

“I know. I want to finish too.”

Anna looks at the last turn again. Then she leans back and lets her shoulders rest.

“They can't hear you from there.”

She looks down at her shoes. Then she laughs once.

Ronan does not tell her the next run will be easy. He only moves his bottle and gives her more room on the bench.

The teacher comes past again. He asks how she feels. Anna says she is all right now. He tells her to rest for the rest of lunch.

At the bell, the three of them walk back. Anna takes the stairs slowly.

“Friday, an easy run,” she tells her friend. “Then Saturday.”

Her friend nods.

In the classroom, Anna opens her notebook. She writes a short line near the running day date.

Ronan sees only two words before she closes it.

Start slowly.

He takes out his own books. Beside him, Anna opens the afternoon lesson to the right page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

awful＝很难受的、糟糕的；cross＝生气、烦躁的；catch＝追上（本章语境）；rest＝休息。

## 理解问题

1. Anna这次四圈练习有没有全程跑完？她后来想到自己哪一圈跑快了？
2. 她为什么对Ronan说话有点冲？后来怎样回应？

## 读句子

**Her friend holds up three fingers.**

拆开看：Her friend / holds up / three fingers.

她的朋友／举起／三根手指。
